# spikes/s1a/Invoke-Spike.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs the whole S1a spike in one command: price, open the spend run, deploy, Q1-Q6, keep the evidence, tear down and close the run.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Sandbox` | string | no | `'personal'` |  |
| `-RunCap` | double | no | `20` |  |
| `-MonthlyCap` | double | no | `150` |  |
| `-Funding` | string | no | `'personal-card'` |  |
| `-AllowedTools` | string | no |  | Comma-separated MCP tool names for the Hosts agent. Default: the read-only host pool and session host tools found in Q3. |
| `-Runtime` | string | no | `'python_3_13'` |  |
| `-AllowUnpriced` | switch | no |  | Open the run even if a line is unpriced (the estimate's note says which). |
| `-NoPause` | switch | no |  | Don't wait before teardown (skips the Q5 portal steps). |
| `-KeepOnFailure` | switch | no |  | Leave the resources up when a step fails, to look at them. Run -TeardownOnly after. |
| `-TeardownOnly` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-Provider` | string | no | `'Foundry'` | Foundry: Claude in Foundry with hosted agents. Anthropic: the fallback (see the third example). |
